thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate on routing-service in eu-west-1. Smart-routing fallbacks increasing by 18% over baseline. Auto-escalating to #incidents.

sahil: acked. paging oncall. taking initial triage.

maria: saw same. errors look like model-variant misroute -> requests landing on legacy-quantized-1 which rejects some newer tokenization headers.

alex: quick note — we pushed a config schema migration earlier in the deploy window that deprecated 'route_defaults.legacy_mode' and introduced 'policy.strict_fallback'. suspecting fallback behavior changed to silent failover to legacy variant.

jin: I can pull the recent config diff. running: `git rev-parse --short HEAD && git show origin/main:infra/routing/schema.yaml`

opsbot: deploy-bot: config apply job started by @deploy-bot for commit 9f3a2b. status: SUCCESS, 3/4 services reloaded, routing-service eu-west-1 reloaded last.

maria: timeline matches. reload after schema migration at 12:37UTC. metrics spike at 12:40.

alex: can we force a strict policy that forbids silent fallback to legacy variant? quick patch: set policy.strict_fallback = true for eu-west-1 route group.

jin: dry-run shows this will route to compatible variants only and return 503 on mismatch instead of failing over. run command: ```
redwoodctl routing update --region eu-west-1 --group product-inference --set policy.strict_fallback=true --dry-run
```

opsbot: obs-agent: customer-impact top-level: 42 customers affected, error-rate peak 12% on EU traffic, latency up 30%.

sahil: paging PD and CS. @maria can you quantify customers with reserved capacity on Dedicated? need to call those accounts.

maria: compiling list now. two Dedicated tenants in eu-west-1: AcmeCorp and Flowly. both on slack and email.

alex: mitigation plan: 1) turn on strict_fallback to stop silent failovers 2) roll back schema change if step 1 causes unacceptable 503s 3) notify customers 4) postmortem. anyone object?

jin: applying step 1 now. running apply: ```
redwoodctl routing apply --region eu-west-1 --group product-inference --set policy.strict_fallback=true
```

opsbot: config-applier: apply started by jin, job id apply-7832.

incident-bot: :pagerduty: PagerDuty triggered: oncall sahil for incident INC-2401.

kate: jumping in for handoff. taking over from sahil. current status?

sahil: handing off to kate. mitigation in progress (strict_fallback applied), monitoring. I need to step out for unrelated high-priority oncall briefly.

kate: copy. I see apply job succeeded. opsbot reports: apply-7832 -> SUCCESS.

opsbot: metrics-agent: post-change metrics: 5xx rate trending down from 12% -> 3% over 6m. fallback-to-legacy count reduced by 92%.

maria: customer-impact update: AcmeCorp saw degraded completions for 18 minutes with 28% failure on some routes. CS engaged and sent interim note. Flowly reported rate-limited errors; they have burst capacity and auto-retried.

kate: ok let's keep strict_fallback for 30m while we validate. if errors spike to >5% we'll rollback schema.

alex: also add a short-term guard: enforce per-route model-compat check at proxy so mismatches return 400 rather than silently hitting legacy. quick proxy change queued.

jin: proxy patch deployed to eu-west-1 edge-proxy (canary=10%). logs show now mismatches are rejected before routing.

opsbot: edge-proxy: canary 10% success. no customer regressions reported in that canary cohort.

maria: CS update: sent targeted note to AcmeCorp ops. they acknowledged incident and asked for ETA on permanent fix.

kate: putting incident into 'mitigated' state. monitoring for 1h. scheduling 1pm postmortem to review schema migration process, deprecation warnings, and default behavior changes. attendees: infra, eng-runtime, eng-ml, cs.

alex: action items: - revert automated migration tooling to fail if deprecated fields present - add lint rule in CI to reject schema changes that change default failover semantics - create canary gating for routing schema deploys.

jin: I'll attach config diffs to the follow-up PR. here's snippet that caused issue: ```yaml
# old
route_defaults:
  legacy_mode: true

# new
policy:
  strict_fallback: false  # default changed to false during migration
```

maria: recommend we notify customers about the schema migration causing unexpected behavior and offer post-incident credits for those impacted. marking for CS to follow up.

kate: noted. I'll run final checks and close incident after 1h stable. great triage all. :white_check_mark:
